name: probit-p4w
description: The user, 11-12 ~16:25: 'Alright let's train ply4', then 'Can we continue to add at least a couple of DAGs in which we may have reason to believe that the routers will split please' / 'If we're doing diverse groups that is'. A MIXED ply-4 field, every line warm-started from a finished or frozen line of its own name (version 0 a byte copy; trees copy model and training state and train on from the state, leagues.py tree warm starts of 2026-11-12): F-P x2 and T-P-Ne capped (limit 4, 1M, noise 0.03, forget 1) x2 from probit-p3's final v301 (trained at ply 3), and D-P-Ne-ctx-grow (router-chain 2, router-credit 5000000) x2 from grow-dag-p1 v395 (trained at ply 1; frozen copy in leagues/starts/grow-dag-p1@395, as the live run keeps only its current state), the grow DAGs whose encourage rule is built for router splits. start_forget 1 throughout (analyst 6.93: the probit's variances sit at the tau equilibrium; trees refuse a forget). entry_ply 4, ply1_entries false, self-games, games_per_cycle 720 (12 entries: 5 round-robins, 660 games), seed 64, prices P2. Rated every 4th cycle (rate_every 4) on rating-only cold games (T 0.02, share 0.5: 3 round-robins, 396 games); scaled plateau (rate_scale sqrt) from cycle 41, cap 101. Tournament chessai-hybrid20 (2026-11-12 ~19:30: hybrid19 with compound's node cap raised from 64 to 128, byte-identical games at plies 1-5, so the start DAG over 64 nodes, grow-dag-p1@395 #1 at 76, plays in fixed point, x0.39 a game at ply 4: models/from-scratch/fastbin/hybrid20/summary.txt; plays the grow6 DAGs byte for byte as chessai-grow6, plies 1-4); training chessai-hybrid6 for F-P and T-P-Ne (train_binary.py --from chessai-hybrid4gfx after create), chessai-grow6 for the DAGs (their recipe's). Read: the ply-4 finals against their ply-3 starts (probit-p3 v301; the DAGs' grow-dag-p1 v395) and against the standing panels, P2 y/v/l @299 and P1 r/e/g/h @300, at plies 4, 3 and 2 (stranger-panel differences, arm_panel.py); within the field trees vs F-P vs DAGs at ply 4 (the in-field cells are matchups). Router splits: the DAG lines' router stats (--log-router-stats) per cycle. Drafted 11-12 ~16:50 by the ply-4 prep fork for the coordinator to review and launch.
